description: This file defines a React functional component named 'FileList' that renders a user interface for managing files and directories. It includes features such as drag-and-drop upload, creating folders, renaming, deleting, downloading files, and selecting multiple entries. It utilizes context for application state and actions.

methods.name: bytes(n)
methods.description: Formats a byte size number into a human-readable string with units (B, KB, MB, GB).

methods.name: openCreateFolder
methods.description: Prompts the user for a new folder name and triggers the creation action.

methods.name: onDrop
methods.description: Handles files dropped via drag-and-drop into the component.

methods.name: onDragOver
methods.description: Prevents default behavior to allow drop.

methods.name: onUpload
methods.description: Handles file selection through the hidden input element for uploading files.

methods.name: onDownload
methods.description: Triggers download for a given file entry.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Confirms and deletes a file or directory entry.

methods.name: onRename
methods.description: Initiates renaming process for a file or directory entry.

methods.name: commitRename
methods.description: Commits the new name for a file or directory after renaming.

methods.name: toggleSelect
methods.description: Toggles selection status of a file or directory in the set of selected items.
